pool.text: Guwahati houses the Court of the District and Sessions Judge, Kamrup.
The Gauhati High Court was promulgated by Governor General Lord Mountbatten.
The Guwahati Radio Station of All India Radio was inaugurated as Shillong-Guwahati Station.
The Headquarter of the Shillong-Guwahati Station shifted from Shillong to Guwahati.
The Saraighat Bridge was constructed by the Hindustan Construction Company.
The refinery at Noonmati was set up by Indian Oil Corporation Limited.
The inaugural sale took place and the first lot of tea was auctioned.
The capital of Assam moved to Dispur from the erstwhile Shillong capital.
The first sitting of the Budget Session of the Assam Legislative Assembly was held.
A kilogram of Maijan Orthodox Golden tea sold for a record-setting price.
Guwahati was ranked the second most polluted city in a report published by IQAir.
